name: artwork_companion
description: Companion plugin for the Artwork One interface: keeps the theme and the ambient display settings on the player, for every screen of it
author: Michal Tamas

volumio_info.details: Installed by the Artwork One installer. Stores the theme (dark, light, system) and the ambient display settings on the player and pushes them to every screen: a display without a touch surface can then be set from a phone.
volumio_info.changelog: 2.1.0: ambient 'Always', and the display's text size and volume. 2.0.1: the pins (quick access on Home) live on the player too. 2.0.0: first release, with Artwork One 2.0
